chapter: The China offer, wedding and Shanghai
title: Two years in China and who went along
summary: They stayed in China from 1934 to 1936; Teddy Buckner, Bumps Myers and Caughey Roberts were among those who went.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs

blocks.x: That's right. So that sent you off to China?
Yes, that's when we went to China.
And how long were you there?
We were in China two years.
Yes, '34 to '36. I came back in '36.
Teddy Buckner went, Bumps Coughy Myers went, ?) Roberts went. He came to New York with Basie on the first ......
It's an indian name. CAUGHEY. An indian name. Yes, he went. Now there's not many others.
